Clara: Quick note - CedarPass agreed to a short customer case tied to our benchmark webinar. Need interview date, quote approval timeline, and embargo window. Doc: https://intranet.redwood/cedarpass-case (request access)

Jon: I can schedule. Customer prefers mornings PT. 20-min interview + 10-min follow-up OK?

Priya: Recording is fine. We need one business outcome line and a technical soundbite about latency improvement. Legal wants quote lines in the doc.

LegalBot: Legal checklist: explicit consent to publish metrics, embargo end date, logo use permission. Send approvals to legal@redwood.com. Customer redlines must be returned within 48 hours.

infra-team: Ops will validate 95p latency and cost per 1k tokens and paste numbers in the doc by EOD tomorrow.

Clara: Timeline: webinar 2024-12-07. Legal needs final quote text by 2024-11-28. Marketing needs final approved copy by 2024-11-30 to build slides and social. Routing: tag leads post-publish with case:cedarpass and route to SFDC queue CS-Launch. Keeping this thread as the single timeline. :calendar:
